batting.name: SS Iyer
batting.dismissal: c TG Southee b CH Morris

batting.name: Yuvraj Singh
batting.dismissal: c KK Nair b CH Morris

batting.name: SV Samson
batting.dismissal: c Yuvraj Singh b AD Mathews

batting.name: SPD Smith
batting.dismissal: c MA Agarwal b A Mishra

batting.name: KK Nair
batting.dismissal: st KM Jadhav b A Mishra

batting.name: DJ Hooda
batting.dismissal: c AD Mathews b Imran Tahir

balls.text: and he connects again, thankfully for DD on the last ball, smashes it down over long on for six. It was a full toss on leg, and right in the zone to be put away
awesome yorker right on the middle stumps, Mathews gets bat on it, the ball doesn't go anywhere and they sneak in a single
towards the stumps now, he struggles to put it away but finds a leg bye
finally he connects, will it go all the way, yes it does! It was slightly slower, well outside leg and he's powered it over the deep midwicket fielder for six
tries another yorker, and JP puts the low full toss away off the pads on leg for two
almost a yorker and it's driven down to long on, brings JP on strike
makes room and muscles the full delivery down to mid off
JP is still struggling, low full toss on the stumps, finds the square leg fielder
nearly in the block hole around off, driven firmly into the covers for one
slower ball well down leg, no idea why he's bowler there, and Mathews waits for it before clipped it fine down the leg side to best fine leg
shuffles across and drives the full ball firmly down to mid off
too full and outside leg, clipped fine down leg to fine leg for one
towards middle and leg from back of length, turned around behind square on leg for one to fine leg
yes, this is why he's in the XI! Length delivery on the off side with the angle, he heaved and connected it from the middle to target the cow corner for a six
strays towards the leg side now, it's too short and Mathews whips it away behind square on leg for four
he's taken it, oh no he's dropped it! Powerful drive muscled down the ground, Rahane caught it around his chest height, got pushed back by the momentum and dropped it
tries another heave for this one outside off again, misses this time
back of the hand slower ball outside off, it was wide enough and Mathews launched it down the ground over the umpire to the long off boundary for four
fullish outside off, driven firmly down to long off
short ball down leg for a wide as Mathews looked to hook it
angled in towards middle and leg, flicked straight to midwicket
full toss on the pads, clipped towards midwicket for one

Yuvi gets a top edge and Karun Nair takes a spectacular running catch at deep backward square leg to get the big wicket! He pulled the short ball, got a top edge and it went pretty high. Nair had to run a long way to his right, Rahane was also coming from deep midwicket but Nair got both hands to it in time
squares up a bit to push the full delivery down to long off. They were looking for two but there wasn't enough time
full outside off, chipped down to long off for one
slightly shorter now towards the stumps, he pushes it down to long on to keep strike

who says slower balls can't be hit for six! It was from back of the hand, but too overpitched, and Yuvi waited for it before launching it with a big drive to the long on boundary a few rows into the stands
makes room, gets a widish delivery outside off and JP cuts it to point for a quick single
back of length slower ball outside off, driven to sweeper cover for one
short ball angled in slightly, he pivots on the back foot and pulls to deep square leg for two
right in the zone around off - that's vintage Yuvi with a powerful drive down the ground and it goes all the way
right in the block hole outside off, blocked towards cover for a quick single
angled across outside off, helps it to third man with a late cut
tries to heave the length delivery on the leg side, misses it completely
low full toss on the pads, whipped away to deep square leg for one
low full toss around off, Yuvi times it beautifully down the ground without much follow through and Nair dives to his right from long on to cut it back
gives a charge to Southee, gets an inside edge onto his pads and gets one
ends with a length delivery around off, driven to cover
bit short of length towards middle, whipped on the leg side for one
another wide, just like the last over - way outside off
angled in slightly towards middle, tucked on the leg side for one
flighted full toss outside off, smashes back with some power and long off cuts it to two
short and flat towards off stump, muscled down to long on for one
flighted outside off, leans forward and drives to sweeper cover
slower ball from the back of hand outside off, JP looks to cut and misses
good reply - right in the block hole and JP digs it out on the off side
he's been pitching them bit too short, JP went on the back foot, shuffled across a bit and pulled it over the fine leg boundary for six
shortish outside off, JP cuts uppishly and it was just wide of point for a catch
back of length outside off, pushed back to the bowler now
140kph, coming in from short of length towards the batsman, he can't get it away
full delivery outside off, driven firmly but it's stopped at cover
drives the full delivery on off, gets an inside edge onto the pad for one on off
quicker and on length on off, pushed back to Hooda
way too wide outside the off stump. Called wide, of course
leans forward and pushes the ball into the covers for one
towards the pads now from middle, clipped off the back foot for one behind square
fullish on the off stump, driven down to long off for one

the slower ball has worked, Iyer has given a catch to mid off! He made some room for the length delivery, wanted to smash it down the ground and mistimed iit for a high catch as Southee came under it comfortably
too full and down the leg side for a wide
bit too wide outside off with the angle, swishes at it to send it to deep point
slower offcutter again, clipped to deep square leg for one
makes room to smash it again, it's a slower offcutter and misses it as the ball misses the leg stump
quicker and shorter just outside off, looked to hook initially and then let it go
too short and angling in, he goes back and pulls it away over the fine leg boundary for six
fullish on the stumps, driven down to long on for one
whipped with the turn from middle stump to leg for one
beats him with the googly! Pitched on middle with some flight, it turned away as JP looked to drive and missed
goes back in the crease and tucks it against the turn to leg for one
more power, four more! Slightly overpitched on middle and he muscled it back along the grounds to beat long on again
tossed up on the stumps, he got his front foot out of the way and smashed it over long on for six
slower ball on short of length, pushed down towards long off for one
slower ball and it turns away down leg for a wide
length delivery with the angle, he makes room and lofts it down the ground off the middle of the bat over long on for six
back of length outside off, he defends on the off side
errs with the length, it's full on the pads and driven away beautifully with the wrists on the leg side for four
was that a drop at sweeper cover? Duminy made room and came down to loft it into the covers, it went high and Tambe came in from the deep but the ball was dying on him and was too tough
back of length outside off, JP defends it back to the bowler
fullish outside off, driven away from the body towards point. He wanted a single but rightly sent back by JP
errs down the leg side now for a wide
mush shorter and wider outside off, loose delivery but he can't clear point
short of length on middle and leg, helps it to short fine leg
length delivery just outside off, cuts off the back foot to sweeper cover
comes down the pitch, Hooda pitches it short and almost down leg, Duminy adjusts and helps it wide of deep midwicket for two
slightly flat outside off, Duminy waited and cut it straight to point
fullish, around but closer to off this time, driven back to the bowler
too full with flight outside off, punched down to mid off
flighted and full well outside off, easy drive down the ground to long off
fullish on the leg stump, clipped to deep square leg for one more
loud appeal for lbw as Iyer took a step down to drive the full delivery on leg to the leg side and missed, but it was going down leg
bit of flight around off stump, Duminy goes down on a knee and paddles it fine to fine leg
flatter now and angling into the batsman, helps it to midwicket for one
flighted and full on the pads again, clipped to deep midwicket for one
too short and wide outside off, but he gets away with it as it's simply pushed down to mid off
leans forward a bit to drive the fullish delivery from off to sweeper cover
full on the pads, driven with the wrists to deep midwicket
flighted and full outside off, driven into the covers for one
bit of flight on the pads, tucked away easily to deep midwicket for one
fullish on off stump, pushed down to mid-off off the front foot
chipped back and Tambe has struck! Agarwal made room as Tmabe targeted the stumps, he got the timing wrong as he looked to loft it over the bowler and Tambe got a simple catch around head height
flat on off, driven firmly to extra cover right at the edge of the circle
pitched up outside off and driven down to long off easily
starts with a googly outside off, Iyer looks to cut and misses
excellent batting from Agarwal! Touch closer to off stump, no slips and he opens the face of the bat late enough to help it fine on the off side and no way third man can get to it
outswing again outside off, opens the face of the bat bit late to beat point again. This one isn't fast enough to beat third man
another clever shot, third four in a row! This one was a bit too wide outside off, he waited on the back foot and chopped it just wide of backward point and away from third man too for four
strays down the leg side and Agarwal places it nicely wide of short fine leg to tuck it away for four behind square. Smart batting from him
short of length and that's been chipped back just over the bowler's right hand for four down the ground. Didn't hit it too hard, just got enough to beat the bowler and the two fielders in the ring
he also gets some outswing from length outside off, batsman lets it go
short of a length outside off again, tucked late to third man to retain strike. 13 from it
much shorter and just outside off, pulled down along the ground to the leg side for one
second beautiful drive of the over, from Iyer this time and it's four! Got width, he leaned forward and connected it from the middle through the covers
back of length now just outside off, Agarwal cuts it late to third man
angled in towards the stumps now, he defends it back
BEAutiful drive from Agarwal for six! It was pitched up just outside off, was in his zone and he lofted it elegantly to the cover boundary all the way
keeps a bit low from short of length outside off as it moves away, Iyer reaches out to drive but misses
136kph, length delivery outside off, not much swing and he lets it go
pushes at it away from the body with some outswing to third man for one
beaten outside off again with some away movement and it beats the edge
angled into the pads now, much easier to play this one and he tucks it away, wide of the midwicket fielder for a four along the ground
draws him forward outside off, he pokes and misses as the ball moves away at good pace
drives this one away from the body outside off to third man with a thick outside edge for one
bit too short and Agarwal gets under it to pull it to the midwicket boundary for a four! The ball was rising on him but he connected well to nearly hit it for six
drives again but misses this time! Width outside off and he swung his arms again but didn't connect this time
beautifully driven and wonderfully stopped by Rahane! It had some room outside off, Agarwal waited for it on the back foot and drove it late but Rahane at point didn't let it pass
angled into the batsman from length, Iyer off the mark by helping it towards midwicket for one
strays down the leg side now for a wide
outswing and gets the outside edge first ball. On length outside off and shaping away, Agarwal pushed at it and got a run to third man

Sixer Southee has hit a four, he's done it on that last ball! Full ball again, outside off he absolutely crunched that through the covers! Went so fast, cover fielder could not stop it, wide long off could not get to it either. Heartbroken Delhi players can't believe it. The ball crashes into the RR dugout, the players start jumping and get into a huddle
full on off, no room for that and it's driven to cover for one
he knew it was going to be full - shuffled across a bit and unleashed the lap-sweep by steering the low full toss between the keeper and short fine leg for four
full and fast near the leg stump, struck down firmly to long on so no time for a second
full again on the stumps, Southee swings his bat and gets a thick edge to send the ball flying over backward point in the gap for two
right in the block hole on middle, Morris steers it to point after making room for a quick one
quicker and flatter on the stumps, Southee defends it back in the nick of time

one more for the googly, one more for Tahir. He's running all the way to Antarctica while celebrating! Faulkner didn't pick that one as it pitched on length, came in and struck the leg stump as Faulkner swept
shorter outside off, he wants to tonk that one too but doesn't middle it and it bounces a couple of times before reaching long on
full on off now, driven back to the bowler
and why didn't they cross - that is why! Gets a length delivery outside off and sweeps it away off the middle of the bat to midwicket boundary for maximum
Hooda's holed out, Tahir gets him with a long hop! It was short and flat, Hooda smashed it to the leg side and found Mathews at long on. The big wicket has come for Delhi
Faulkner makes a lot of room, NCN sends it down leg from outside leg and Faulkner gets a thin inside edge to get a four fine down leg. Lucky one that
full around the off stump, no room and it's punched down to long on
on the stumps now and Hooda flicks it away on the leg side in the gap for two more
yorker-length wide down the leg side
that's a well-directed short ball with the angle and at good pace, Hooda defends and gets an edge to the third man region to get to his fifty
makes room again, NCN aims for the batsman, who tucks the ball with the angle to deep midwicket
makes room, slogs and gets an thick outside edge to send the ball flying between the keeper and short third man for four
googly turning in from outside off, pushed into the covers
unusual shot as Hooda tries a reverse sweep, gets one hand off the bat and manages an edge over the keeper for one
way outside off and turning away, called a wide
Hooda thought it was a googly and swept the length ball from outside off, it got the toe of the bat and they take two
full delivery on the stumps, pushed back to the bowler but Mishra dives and lets it go
turns away after pitching outside off, it's cut towards deep backward point and they take two more
Jadhav appeals for something as Faulkner cuts and misses
length delivery turning away from outside off, steered wide of point for one
drifts it in towards the batsman, this one's steered towards deep midwicket with soft hands and they come back for the second
comes down again and manages some bat to get a single to square leg
Faulkner can wait, Hooda unleashes another six! Dances down the track to take it on the full and clobbers it over long on a good 10 rows
on length on middle and leg, clipped to deep midwicket for one
it's a googly, it's a wicket! Jinxy charged down, the length ball turned in sharply from outside off as he looked to slog and missed it completely. Ball clips the leg stump

and again - gets a full toss, goes behind the wicket, smashes it to leg, it goes for six! Main difference being this one was a catch for deep midwicket but Manoj Tiway dropped it there and it went over the boundary
exposes his stumps by going to off side again, get a full toss and smashes it over the wide long-on boundary for a six! His back foot went behind the wicket while doing that
full and wide again, he doesn't middle it as it goes down to long off for one
full toss around off, but he can't clear deep midwicket
low full toss well outside off, he chases and maybe gets an edge, not given a wide
Jinxy comes down and sends it down the ground by taking it on the full, to long on
rushes through a little bit, he swats it to leg for one
bit too short, Rahane rocks back and tonks it over midwicket with a pull for big six

oh, he's fluffed a run out chance - Yuvraj! Hooda cut the ball to point, Rahane wanted the run and took off, Hooda replied late and Mathews did the needful by throwing the ball to non-striker's but Yuvraj didn't collect it
takes a step down and swats it through covers for one more
he comes down, Yuvi pitches it flat and short, Hooda pushes it on off for one
flighted outside off, driven through the covers for one
on the other side now - four more! He exposed is stumps again and chased the ball outside off to swish at it, beat point with that and found the boundary
shuffles across this time, takes the ball on the full and flicks the ball away behind square on the leg side in the gap for two. Didn't use much power there, just steered the ball
129kph, it's pretty full and Hooda has launched it up and away over the long on boundary into the stands with a whip, using his wrists, for six!
swings it in and it's nearly a yorker, pushed down to long on for one
Jinxy charges down, Mathews throws in a slower one to beat Rahane but it's given a wide outside off
length delivery cutting in from off, chipped in the air down to long on for one
cuts it in from outside off, worked away behind square on leg
fullish outside off, driven through the covers in the gap
flighted well outside off, it was the googly and Hooda got a bottom edge while driving it
comes down a step and flicks the ball from around off to deep midwicket in the gap for two
quicker one just outside off, Rahane had to react quickly to punch it down to long on
shorter and turning away from just outside off, pulled awkwardly to leg for one
length delivery turning away from outside off, cut to point
errs down the leg side for s wide
turning away from length outside off, Rahane defends on the off side
full and outside off, flicked using the wrists down to long on
it's that one again - the googly! Pitched on length outside off and turning in sharply, Binny hardly moves his feet and was trapped right in front of middle and leg, that was plumb
fuller on the stumps, pushed down to long on against the turn for one
way outside off and turning away, for a wide
errs towards leg stump, clipped off the pads to the leg side for one
flighted and fullish on the stumps, flicked down to long on
the googly does it again, he's stumped! Already 10 runs from the over, Nair charged again for the widish delivery and missed it completely as it came in. Easy work for Jadhav
another googly, this one from outside off, and he reverse sweeps it well this time to beat third man for four
turns the googly into the batsman and he tucks it to deep square leg bit wide of Tahir for two
reverse sweeps the straighter delivery and finds short third man
come down to make room and drives the fullish delivery inside out just wide of cover for four
full and drifting in towards middle and leg, driven down to long on for one
animated appeal from Tahir for lbw even though it pitched outside leg, doesn't matter if it was hitting the stumps or not. They sneak a leg bye too
turning away from length outside off, pushed into the covers
flighted and low full toss on middle, flicked to deep midwicket for one

nearly run out! Touch shorter and outside off, Nair pushed the ball towards cover point and stumbled when he was sent back by Rahane after first couple of steps. Made it back just in time because it wasn't a direct hit
flighted and full on off, whipped with the wrists to the cow corner and Unadkat dives to his right to keep it to two
full on the pads, clipped to the leg side in the deep for two
waits for it to turn by going on the back foot and whips it against the turn to send it wide of deep midwicket for two
goes back and punches the ball from outside off to cover point
pitched up just outside off, swept against the turn by Nair to the deep square leg boundary for four
on length on the stumps, pushed towards midwicket
oh he's got a wicket off the second ball, it was a googly! Pitched it up just outside off, Smith came down again and looks like he didn't pick that one, lofted it down the ground and found long on
flighted towards middle and leg, Smithy comes down and pushes it down to mid on
comes down a step and pushes the ball from outside off to mid off for one
makes room for a change, Smithy, and slashes the widish delivery over point region for four in the gap
targets the off stump again, not giving any room, and it's tucked to fine leg for one more
cuts the back of length ball in towards off stump, worked to leg side for one
touch shorter and Rahane pulls it nicely to deep midwicket before Yuvi keeps it in
slightly back of length and coming in, keeps low as Rahane defends on leg
overpitched, he gets the middle of the bat now and the ball races away to the cover boundary! Pitched up, wide outside off, crunched over the covers
pretty wide outside off, he reaches out and gets a bottom edge to to cover point
slower offcutter well outside off, Smithy tries to smash it away but misses it completely
goes towards off as usual and whips the ball to midwicket
short ball outside off, he goes on the toes and guides it late to third man
too full and wide, Jinxy unleashes a beautiful drive but finds cover point
straight to Yuvi at deep midwicket, he didn't have to move an inch! Pressure building with only two from the over so far, Samson plays a cross-bat slog to the length delivery and finds Yuvraj
connects this time but mistimes the pull and it lobs over Mathews to fall safe
pulls, and Rahane misses now! Short ball angled in, misses the ball, it hits him just outside the off stump line
back of length on off stump, he shuffles across and tucks it to leg for one
outside off and a touch shorter, Samson wants to smash it to leg but misses
slightly full on the stumps, pushed down to mid on
angled into the pads, clipped to deep midwicket for one
closer to the stumps now, slightly slower, he waits and guides it to third man for one
room again and this is a cracking cut past backward point off the back foot for four! It was short, there was room, and he swung his arms
back of length outside off, he cuts and misses this time. Extra bounce made the ball go over the bat
pitched up now and Rahane tonks it away to the cow corner from off stump for 87 metres away from him
he wants to pull the short ball, it didn't bounce as much and the DD players appealed for lbw. Too high for that
comes down a touch and drives the ball down beautifully from outside off, but mid-off cuts it to one
shuffles down and across, and flicks the ball to leg for one more
on length on the pads, clipped to deep midwicket for one
yes, no, yes, almost run out! Rahane pushed the ball to cover point, came down, Samson also took a couple of steps, but there was no single and he went back just in time
that's more like Rahane, the classical cover drive with a forward lean for a cracking four
Jinxy comes down and connects for a six! Short of length delivery on middle and leg, he heaved on leg, slightly uncharacteristic for him, but this is T20, and that is a six
on length and well outside off, pushed to point carefully
length delivery angling in, Samson gets a leading edge while trying to turn it to leg but got it over cover point for two more
pretty wide outside off and moving away, Samson drives and misses
back of length around off, chipped over the bowler off the back foot for two
straighter delivery this time, he defends it back
angled down leg, Samson whips it away to the leg side and Tahir at fine leg over-runs the ball and it goes past his left hand for four
errs down towards leg stump, Rahane turns it away down leg to fine leg for two
back of length and brings it closer to off now, Rahane stays back and defends
much fuller and wider, driven firmly into the covers
beaten, there's a loud appeal for caught behind, but turned down! Rahane looked to defend this time as the ball moved away and across him, the keeper was confident but there wasn't anything on that
swing and a miss! Angled across the off stump, Rahane looks to cut and misses. Skiddy ball that one
slightly back of length around off, Rahane pushes towards point
